sloka: तस्य वै यजमानस्य पशुम् इन्द्रो जहार ह ।प्रणष्टे तु पशौ विप्रो राजानम् इदम् अब्रवीत् ॥१-६१-६॥
transliteration: tasya vai yajamānasya paśum indro jahāra ha ।praṇaṣṭe tu paśau vipro rājānam idam abravīt ॥1-61-6॥

translations.english: While he was performing the sacrifice Indra stole away the sacrificial animal. The animal could not be traced. Hence the priest said to the king:
